title: AutoMorpheBuilder patches.json
description: Structural schema for the patch toggle map. Top level is keyed by repo (owner/repo). Each repo-level value is keyed by Android package id with a propertyNames regex constraint, and each package-level value is an object of {patch-name: boolean} toggles. See update-patches.yml for how this file is regenerated.

additionalProperties.description: A patch repo, keyed by Android package id.

propertyNames.description: Android package id (matches the keys under config.json patch_repos).
